name: im-mcp-codeagent
description: Model Android and in-vehicle capabilities, export upstream Agent function schemas, expose the same contract as MCP tools, and invoke a thin real-device executor.

interface.shortDescription: Project app capabilities into Agent schemas and MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: BRIDGE turns source, APK, PRD, or device observations into a portable analysis contract, projects active capabilities into upstream Agent function schemas and a host-side MCP server, and invokes a thin privileged Android executor on real devices.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this Android app and produce a verified BRIDGE capability model.
Export this BRIDGE capability model as function schemas for an upstream Agent.
Serve this BRIDGE analysis as MCP tools for a connected device.
Report unverified or broken paths in this BRIDGE capability model.
